name: secure-checker
description: Security checker for source code and live websites - quick or detailed scans with remediation reports

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/cli && npm run build -w packages/vscode-extension && npm run build -w packages/web-extension
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build -w packages/vscode-extension && npm run package -w packages/vscode-extension
scripts.package:web-extension: npm run build -w packages/web-extension && npm run package -w packages/web-extension
